checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices are also on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, authorizations and permits, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No additional mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead such as a facilities fee or handling fee appears on the list.
D-embalming is printed on page 1 and the $795 embalming price is also on page 1.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is printed on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is also on page 2.
Direct cremation is offered with options including container provided by purchaser, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate cash-advance crematory fee is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered service appears only inside a description.
The list contains only separately priced items and the four required single-price items, with no optional combination package offered.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires purchase of any item beyond the wording of the required disclosures.
No claim about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no required disclosure is shown in a way that is hard to notice.
